prompt:
Using the uploaded SBML model, simulate from time 0 through 1800 with exactly 120 equal output intervals (121 output points including both endpoints). Keep all initial values and parameters unchanged. Retain numerical time-course data for all dynamic species. Do not fetch another model or use external sources. No plot or secondary question analysis is requested.
Integration API clarification: this is a locally uploaded model. Omit the optional biomodel_id field entirely; do not pass null or invent an ID. Use use_uploaded_sbml_file=true. In this implementation time_data.interval is the NUMBER of output intervals, not the time step. Use duration=1800.0 and interval=120. Only a simulate_model tool call is needed.
